title: Round 2 verdict for recorder: green, P1 fixed by amendment 1
context: Recorder round 2 at d906cbc6 (previous head 7b4d7dc4): the full suite passed (5085 app tests, 178 relay and message-package tests). code-reviewer and conformance-auditor ran from rendered briefs and found nothing new; the auditor marked 16.1 to 16.19 MET and 16.20 not applicable (a device criterion). candidates carried P1 (onset baseline reset on pause), and the validator judged it fixed: the setter now calls VoiceLevelSmoother.hush(), and the two new 16.17 tests pass. record and verdict gave green with no blockers.
options: Mark recorder green and review it no further; carry on with amendment 2 (voice-peaks) and amendment 3 (windows-reminder-guard)
Run a third recorder round to re-check the Android frame-time median
Reopen recorder for an Android performance amendment
option_reasons: The pipeline verdict is green, and a green MSP is reviewed no further.
Review rounds judge the diff against the spec; the device measurement is the main thread's lab work and goes to the final report.
The lab probe showed that an empty Comets layer redrawing at 60 fps costs the same 16.5 ms raster on the emulator, so the cost is the emulator's GPU present wait, not the drawing; no defect to amend.
outcome: Recorder is green after round 2 and ships. Amendment 2 for voice-peaks continues: its spec review found that the rate guard missed large finite rates, and the record now adds value-based rate classes, an opens domain and a lifted windowFrames test. A follow-up spec review comes next, then the build on mitosis/voice-peaks. Amendment 3 for windows-reminder-guard follows.
